question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**provides**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'The Historical Work of Tacitus'. • In the fourth blank, the most appropriate word is 'provides'. • It means 'to give something to somebody or make something available for somebody to use; to supply something'. (किसी को कुछ देना या प्रयोग के लिए उपलब्‍ध कराना; किसी वस्‍तु की आपूर्ति) • *Example: This book will **provide** you with all the information you need.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **negates**: to stop something from having any effect. (बेअसर या अशक्त करना; बेकार करना; निष्फल करना) • **removes**: to take somebody/something off or away. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को हटा या मिटा देना) • **strangulates**: strangle; throttle. (दबाना; गला घोंटना) • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** Correct Passage:__ *If writers only dared to dare, a Suetonius or a Tacitus of the Novel could exist, for the Novel is essentially the history of manners, turned into a story and a play, as is History itself often enough. And there is no other difference than this: that the one, the Novel, cloaks its manners under the disguise of invented characters, while the other, History, **provides** names and addresses. Only, the Novel (5) ___________ much deeper than History.* 47:Td7f, The correct answer is '**probes**'.
